## Instructions for the AI agent

Add the 404 & 500 block to this project exactly as specified here. If the user did not say which variant, ask, or install the first one.

1. **Setup first.** Look for `ui/styles/kit.css` in the folder the `@/` import alias points to (`src/` in most Next.js apps, otherwise the project root). If it is missing, apply the one-time setup first: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/setup.md

4. **Register the CSS.** In `ui/styles/kit.css`, add these lines directly above the `@source` line, skipping any already there:


5. **Create the block.** Save the variant verbatim as its own file, for example `components/blocks/error-pages/<variant>.tsx` inside the `@/` folder, then render it from a page. Change the copy (names, prices, links) only if the user asks.

**Rules.** Copy every file verbatim: do not restyle, rename classes, reformat, "improve", convert to another styling approach (CSS modules, styled-components, inline styles) or add npm packages. React and Tailwind CSS v4 only. Keep `'use client'` lines where they are. If a file already exists with identical contents, leave it. ## Specification

### Block: Error pages (404 and 500)

Calm full-page error states: what happened, whose fault it is and two ways forward. Built only from ui-kit components, Tailwind utilities and an inline SVG illustration; each variant is one self-contained client component file.

#### Anatomy
```
root                          @container, rounded-xl, 1px border, bg-background, px 20, py 48 → 64 (@2xl)
  column (centred, max 36rem, gap 24, text-center)
    illustration              inline SVG 240×168 (w 208 → 240 @md), aria-hidden, built from shapes:
                              muted disc r70 + dashed ring r80 (stroke = border colour, dash 3 7) + a scene
    code line                 mono 13px/500: “404 · Page not found” (primary-text) / “500 · Server error” (warning-text)
    h1                        display 28px → 34px (@2xl), 600, tracking-tight
    lead                      15px muted

404 scene: a tilted page card (fill card, border stroke, grey text bars) and a magnifier in the primary colour with a “?”.
  The lead names the failed path in a mono chip (bg-muted, 13px).
  search: <form role="search"> max 28rem — Field( InputGroup( InputIcon search + Input aria-label “Search Lumen” ) + secondary Button “Search” ) + FieldError
  actions: primary “Back to home” (home icon, link) + outline “Contact support” (mailto link)
  below (max 48rem, mt 48): h2 13px muted, aria-live polite — “Popular pages” | “Results for “q”” | “No pages match “q”…”
    list: 2 columns from @xl; each a bordered bg-card link row: 36px muted icon tile, title 500 + truncated description, chevron-right

500 scene: three server units (rounded rects, card fill, border stroke) with two status lights each; the middle unit’s first light is warning.
  actions: primary “Try again” (refresh-cw, loading while retrying) + outline “Go to dashboard” (home icon, link)
  status line: role="status", tabIndex -1, min-height 20px — empty | “Still not loading…” | circle-check + “We’re back. Reloading your page…” (success-text)
  details box (max 28rem, bordered, bg-muted/60, p-16, left-aligned): <dl> Error ID (mono, truncate) + CopyButton (aria-label “Copy error ID”) · Time (mono)
    + sentence asking to include the ID + “System status” link with external-link icon
```

#### Behaviour
- 404 search validates on submit: empty → “Type what you were looking for.” under the field and focus back in it. A query filters the popular pages by title and description (case-insensitive); with no match, show the full list under the “No pages match” heading.
- 500 retry: the button shows `loading` for ~1.4s. In the demo the first retry fails (status text) and the second recovers (success text, focus moves to the status line, Try again disabled). In an app, call Next.js `reset()` instead.

#### Visual rules
- Semantic tokens only, including inside the SVG (fill-muted, fill-card, stroke-border, stroke-primary, fill-warning, fill-muted-foreground/20–40). No gradients, no shadows, no animation on the illustration.
- Copy is plain and calm; no jokes.

#### Responsive
- One centred column at every width; the actions wrap; the popular pages go to one column below @xl (36rem). Works from 360px.

#### Accessibility
- One h1 per page; illustrations aria-hidden; the search form is a search landmark with a named input; errors are announced.
- The popular-pages heading is a polite live region so filtering is announced.

#### Acceptance checks
- 404: submitting an empty search shows the error; searching “invoice” leaves only “Invoices” and the heading reads “Results for “invoice””.
- 500: first Try again → “Still not loading…”; second → “We’re back…”. The copy button copies the error ID and says “Copied”.
- Both pages pass axe in light and dark.

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { Field, FieldError } from '@/ui/components/field';
import { Input, InputGroup, InputIcon } from '@/ui/components/input';
import { Icon, type IconName } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

const PAGES: { title: string; description: string; href: string; icon: IconName }[] = [
  { title: 'Dashboard', description: 'Cash, runway and this month’s spend', href: '#dashboard', icon: 'layout-dashboard' },
  { title: 'Invoices', description: 'Send, track and reconcile invoices', href: '#invoices', icon: 'file' },
  { title: 'Reports', description: 'P&L, balance sheet and cash flow', href: '#reports', icon: 'bar-chart' },
  { title: 'Help centre', description: 'Guides, how-tos and troubleshooting', href: '#help', icon: 'info' },
  { title: 'Team settings', description: 'Members, roles and permissions', href: '#settings', icon: 'users' },
  { title: 'System status', description: 'Live uptime for every Lumen service', href: '#status', icon: 'activity' },
];

/** A calm illustration from plain shapes: a page that drifted out of its orbit, and a magnifier. */
function LostPage() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 240 168" className="w-52 @md:w-60" aria-hidden="true">
      <circle cx="120" cy="88" r="70" className="fill-muted" />
      <circle cx="120" cy="88" r="80" fill="none" strokeDasharray="3 7" strokeLinecap="round" className="stroke-border" strokeWidth="1.5" />
      <g transform="rotate(-8 108 84)">
        <rect x="76" y="40" width="64" height="84" rx="8" strokeWidth="1.5" className="fill-card stroke-border" />
        <rect x="88" y="56" width="32" height="6" rx="3" className="fill-muted-foreground/40" />
        <rect x="88" y="70" width="40" height="4" rx="2" className="fill-muted-foreground/20" />
        <rect x="88" y="80" width="36" height="4" rx="2" className="fill-muted-foreground/20" />
        <rect x="88" y="90" width="40" height="4" rx="2" className="fill-muted-foreground/20" />
        <rect x="88" y="100" width="24" height="4" rx="2" className="fill-muted-foreground/20" />
      </g>
      <circle cx="156" cy="104" r="20" strokeWidth="5" className="fill-background stroke-primary" />
      <path d="M170 119 186 135" strokeWidth="7" strokeLinecap="round" className="stroke-primary" />
      <path d="M150 99a6 6 0 1 1 8 5.6c-1.3.5-2 1.6-2 3V109" fill="none" strokeWidth="3" strokeLinecap="round" className="stroke-primary" />
      <circle cx="156" cy="114.5" r="1.8" className="fill-primary" />
      <circle cx="58" cy="44" r="3" className="fill-primary/40" />
      <circle cx="196" cy="58" r="2" className="fill-muted-foreground/30" />
    </svg>
  );
}

export default function NotFoundPage() {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string>();

  const search = (e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const q = query.trim();
    if (!q) {
      setError('Type what you were looking for.');
      (e.currentTarget.elements.namedItem('q') as HTMLInputElement).focus();
      return;
    }
    setSubmitted(q);
  };

  const term = submitted?.toLowerCase();
  const results = term ? PAGES.filter((p) => `${p.title} ${p.description}`.toLowerCase().includes(term)) : PAGES;

  return (
    <div className="@container w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-5 py-12 @2xl:py-16">
      <div className="mx-auto grid max-w-xl justify-items-center gap-6 text-center">
        <LostPage />
        <div className="grid gap-3">
          <p className="font-mono text-sm font-medium text-primary-text">404 · Page not found</p>
          <h1 className="font-display text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight @2xl:text-4xl">We can’t find that page</h1>
          <p className="text-md text-muted-foreground">
            Nothing lives at <span className="rounded-sm bg-muted px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm text-foreground">/reports/q3-summary</span>. The
            link may be old, or the page may have moved. Try a search, or head back home.
          </p>
        </div>

        <form role="search" noValidate onSubmit={search} className="w-full max-w-md text-left">
          <Field invalid={!!error}>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <InputGroup className="flex-1">
                <InputIcon>
                  <Icon name="search" />
                </InputIcon>
                <Input
                  name="q"
                  type="search"
                  aria-label="Search Lumen"
                  placeholder="Search pages and help articles"
                  value={query}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setQuery(e.target.value);
                    if (error) setError(undefined);
                  }}
                />
              </InputGroup>
              <Button type="submit" variant="secondary">
                Search
              </Button>
            </div>
            <FieldError>{error}</FieldError>
          </Field>
        </form>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2">
          <Button asChild>
            <a href="#home">
              <Icon name="home" />
              Back to home
            </a>
          </Button>
          <Button variant="outline" asChild>
            <a href="mailto:support@lumen.dev">Contact support</a>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mx-auto mt-12 grid max-w-3xl gap-3">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground" aria-live="polite">
          {submitted ? (results.length ? `Results for “${submitted}”` : `No pages match “${submitted}”. Try a broader word, or pick one of these.`) : 'Popular pages'}
        </h2>
        <ul className="grid gap-2 @xl:grid-cols-2">
          {(results.length ? results : PAGES).map((p) => (
            <li key={p.href}>
              <a
                href={p.href}
                className="group flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-border bg-card p-3 transition-colors duration-150 outline-none hover:bg-muted focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/45"
              >
                <span className="grid size-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-md bg-muted text-muted-foreground group-hover:bg-background">
                  <Icon name={p.icon} />
                </span>
                <span className="grid min-w-0 flex-1 text-sm">
                  <span className="font-medium">{p.title}</span>
                  <span className="truncate text-muted-foreground">{p.description}</span>
                </span>
                <Icon name="chevron-right" className="text-muted-foreground" />
              </a>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { CopyButton } from '@/ui/components/copy-button';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

const ERROR_ID = 'err_7f3a91c2e04b';
const OCCURRED = '2026-11-25 14:32:08 UTC';

/** A calm illustration from plain shapes: a server rack with one amber light. */
function QuietRack() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 240 168" className="w-52 @md:w-60" aria-hidden="true">
      <circle cx="120" cy="88" r="70" className="fill-muted" />
      <circle cx="120" cy="88" r="80" fill="none" strokeDasharray="3 7" strokeLinecap="round" className="stroke-border" strokeWidth="1.5" />
      {[44, 78, 112].map((y, i) => (
        <g key={y}>
          <rect x="72" y={y} width="96" height="28" rx="7" strokeWidth="1.5" className="fill-card stroke-border" />
          <rect x="84" y={y + 11} width="36" height="6" rx="3" className="fill-muted-foreground/25" />
          <circle cx="146" cy={y + 14} r="3.5" className={i === 1 ? 'fill-warning' : 'fill-muted-foreground/25'} />
          <circle cx="156" cy={y + 14} r="3.5" className="fill-muted-foreground/25" />
        </g>
      ))}
      <path d="M58 150h124" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" className="stroke-border" />
      <circle cx="190" cy="46" r="3" className="fill-warning/50" />
      <circle cx="52" cy="70" r="2" className="fill-muted-foreground/30" />
    </svg>
  );
}

export default function ServerErrorPage() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<'error' | 'retrying' | 'still-down' | 'recovered'>('error');
  const attempts = useRef(0);
  const message = useRef<HTMLParagraphElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (state === 'recovered') message.current?.focus();
  }, [state]);

  // Demo: the first retry still fails, the second one works
  const retry = () => {
    setState('retrying');
    attempts.current += 1;
    setTimeout(() => setState(attempts.current >= 2 ? 'recovered' : 'still-down'), 1400);
  };

  return (
    <div className="@container w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-5 py-12 @2xl:py-16">
      <div className="mx-auto grid max-w-xl justify-items-center gap-6 text-center">
        <QuietRack />
        <div className="grid gap-3">
          <p className="font-mono text-sm font-medium text-warning-text">500 · Server error</p>
          <h1 className="font-display text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight @2xl:text-4xl">Something went wrong on our side</h1>
          <p className="text-md text-muted-foreground">
            It’s not you. Our servers hit an unexpected error and couldn’t load this page. We’ve been alerted and are already looking into it.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2">
          <Button onClick={retry} loading={state === 'retrying'} disabled={state === 'recovered'}>
            <Icon name="refresh-cw" />
            Try again
          </Button>
          <Button variant="outline" asChild>
            <a href="#home">
              <Icon name="home" />
              Go to dashboard
            </a>
          </Button>
        </div>

        <p
          ref={message}
          role="status"
          tabIndex={-1}
          className={
            state === 'recovered'
              ? 'flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium text-success-text outline-none'
              : 'min-h-5 text-sm text-muted-foreground outline-none'
          }
        >
          {state === 'still-down' && 'Still not loading. Give it a minute, or check the status page for updates.'}
          {state === 'recovered' && (
            <>
              <Icon name="circle-check" />
              We’re back. Reloading your page…
            </>
          )}
        </p>

        <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/60 p-4 text-left text-sm">
          <dl className="grid grid-cols-[auto_minmax(0,1fr)] items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-2">
            <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Error ID</dt>
            <dd className="flex min-w-0 items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <code className="truncate font-mono text-foreground">{ERROR_ID}</code>
              <CopyButton value={ERROR_ID} aria-label="Copy error ID" />
            </dd>
            <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Time</dt>
            <dd className="font-mono text-foreground tabular-nums">{OCCURRED}</dd>
          </dl>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">
            Contacting support? Include the error ID so we can find what happened.{' '}
            <a href="#status" className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-medium text-primary-text hover:underline">
              System status
              <Icon name="external-link" size={14} />
            </a>
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Shared files

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```
